---
title: "xumrgcs"
---

## Description

Merge SUPP and CO to the input SDTM dataset.

## Parameters

**`inds`**

: Name(s) of the input dataset(s)

  *Required:* Yes

**`sourcelib`**

: Name of the input library

  *Required:* Yes

**`supp`**

: Flag that determines whether to merge SUPP dataset or not

  *Required:* No

  *Default:* `Y`

**`co`**

: Flag that determines whether to merge CO dataset or not

  *Required:* No

  *Default:* `Y`

**`debug`**

: Flag that determines whether to delete temporary datasets or not

  *Required:* No

  *Default:* `N`

## Examples

```sas
%xumrgcs(dmae,sdtm,supp=Y,co=N);
%xumrgcs(pr,sdtm,supp=Y,co=Y);
```
